title: Listed Gradle distributions and their pinned bytes
description: The LISTED RELEASES half of the JVM egress decision. github.com and release-assets.githubusercontent.com are reachable from the resolution container for one reason — services.gradle.org 307-redirects distribution downloads there and no gradle wrapper can bootstrap otherwise — and the proxy cannot narrow that to a path, because for HTTPS squid sees only CONNECT host:443 and seeing more would mean terminating TLS. So the host is allowed and the BYTES are pinned here. bin/jvm-resolve.sh injects `distributionSha256Sum` into the SCRATCH COPY's wrapper properties and the Gradle wrapper verifies the zip itself; a version absent from this file does not run. That refusal is the entire value of the arrangement: unlisted means nobody recorded what bytes to expect, and downloading anyway through a host permitted only because of the pin is exactly the trust this removes.

provenanceOfTheseHashes.description: Where the hashes came from and how far that goes. Required prose rather than an optional note, because a pin list whose own provenance is unstated invites being read as stronger than it is.

distributions.description: One entry per distribution any repo in scope may download. Derived from what the fleet's gradle-wrapper.properties files actually declare, never invented — a speculative entry is a widening nobody asked for.

version.description: Gradle version exactly as it appears in the distributionUrl. Matched literally against what the wrapper asks for, so `8.9` and `8.9.0` are different entries and only one of them is what the file says.

kind.description: Which distribution. `bin` and `all` are DIFFERENT ZIPS with different hashes, and a lookup that ignored this would pin the wrong bytes and fail confusingly at the wrapper rather than clearly here.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex, 64 characters. The wrapper compares literally; an uppercase or truncated value would not merely mismatch, it would mismatch for a reason unrelated to the bytes.

repos.description: How many repos in scope declare this distribution. Informational — it says whether an entry is still earning its place, and an entry that reaches zero is a candidate for removal rather than a permanent widening.

confirmedBy.description: Who independently checked this hash against a source other than the one it was fetched from, or null. REQUIRED so it cannot be quietly omitted: null is a statement that nobody has, and an absent field would read the same while committing to nothing. Every entry is null as of 2026-08-27 — the hashes came from Gradle's own published sums over TLS, which is a reasonable anchor and not a second opinion.
